notes.title: First Game Release - Thank You!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

This is my first time developing and releasing a game, and I know there may be a few rough edges.

Still, I truly appreciate everyone who's taken the time to play it.

Your feedback and support mean a lot to me as a solo developer. Thank you again for checking it out!



---



Android Beta Test

I'm currently working on an Android version of the game.

If you're interested in joining the beta test,

please email me at developer.ch86@gmail.com using your Google account email address.

Please note: The Android beta is a paid app, so you'll need to purchase it to participate in the test.



Thanks again!
